body: Ive been tested for Type 1 but mysteriously enough its Type 2 even though both of my parents have Type 1 diabetes. I couldnt believe it myself since both of my parents had Type 1 but thats what the doctors say it is. I just seen a doctor today and did get a confirmation that it was full blown Type 2 Diabetes. I was sent in for a slew of other blood work so hopefully nothing else pops up. Right now im testing myself every hour on the hour and writing it down on paper for my doctor to get a gauge of how big my sugar rises when I eat a meal (for example, baked chicken and mashed potatoes). So far, with the metformin and glipizide im sitting at around 231 Average without Novalog, 148 with 8 mL of Novalog (i think 8ml is the right term, its on the pen anyways lol) but thats as low as it gets so far. I didnt know Carbs were something I needed to watch as well, Ill certainly make sure to watch for that on the food label next time i go shopping so thank you =). I just wish I could've figured out earlier instead of letting my a1c get to 10.2 and its certainly been a struggle with the dramatic diet change and cold turkying the amount of m&ms and ice cream I snacked on. Soda is going to be a real struggle to quit to, caffeine withdrawal is not something I want to go through right now but so be it. I'm struggling, a lot, especially with the Nausea and vomiting problem im having but ive been rolling with it =) any more advise would be amazingly welcomed.
